title: Case D — high-rise among city blocks

units.length: m (model scale; converted from the workbook's millimetres)

frame.origin: tower centre on the ground plane (the array's bounding box is centred on it)
frame.x: +x streamwise at WD = 0 (the 0 deg thermistor field is exactly y-mirror symmetric; the split-fibre U is positive at the stream-like points and negative in the tower's windward horseshoe)
frame.wind_direction_rotation: +x toward +y, read from Figure 4 of the data paper. The array is exactly y-mirror symmetric, so the measurements alone cannot settle the rotation sense (headings +theta and -theta give exact mirror fields); solved Eddy3D fields score R 0.80 (22.5 deg) and 0.85 (45 deg) in Figure 4's sense, 0.40 and 0.17 mirrored.

column_meaning.point_id: the tunnel's own measurement point number
column_meaning.config: configuration key: 'default', Case C centre building '0D'/'1D'/'2D', Case E state 'bc' (before) / 'ac' (after construction)
column_meaning.wind_direction_deg: AIJ wind direction in degrees; 0 is the case's reference direction (see frame)
column_meaning.V: m/s, mean velocity along +y (sign unified: positive toward +y)
column_meaning.Vs: m/s, mean omnidirectional scalar wind speed (thermistor); Case D also lists |U| of the split-fibre probe under Vs for its 33 vector points
column_meaning.campaign: 'wind_tunnel' (model scale) or 'field' (a full-scale observation: Cases F, G, M)
